# Hashes

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The digests of a file.

`sha256`, `sha1` and `md5` are flat hashes of the whole file. The
`authenticode_*` digests are the digest a signature covers: the
Authenticode image hash for PE files, or the subject-interface-package
digest for scripts and other signable formats. SHA-1 and MD5 are for
matching OS and imported data only, never the sole basis of a decision
(ADR 0008).

Appears at: `/file/hashes`, `/process/hashes`, `/process/parent/hashes`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authenticode_sha1` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{40}$` | 1.0.0 | SHA-1 signature digest. Interop only. |
| `authenticode_sha256` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | 1.0.0 | SHA-256 signature digest. |
| `md5` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{32}$` | 1.0.0 | MD5 of the file. Interop only. |
| `sha1` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{40}$` | 1.0.0 | SHA-1 of the file. Interop only. |
| `sha256` | string | no |  | matches `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | 1.0.0 | SHA-256 of the file. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
